debugData.name: Desert dunes (KTX2 cube)
debugData.description: The desert-dunes cube as one ETC1S KTX2 cube file at 1024 per face (640 KB, its mips in the file) in place of six 2048 PNGs (22.6 MB), made with ktx create --cubemap in the faces' order scene01's desert-dunes lists them (p311 Phase 1). Switch to it in the sky box tab.
